sentences.text: Mr. V.S. Rawat, A.G.A. for the State.

Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in Fir No. 24 of 2024, under Section 323, 376, 504 Ipc, Police
Station Kotwali Kotdwar, District Pauri Garhwal.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the informant was already married and had a child.
She was in litigation of divorce with her husband.
It is during that period the applicant came close to her, established physical relations with her.
The informant started staying with the applicant.
They stayed together for seven years.
A child was also born from the applicant.
Subsequently, the FIR records that the applicant stopped talking to the informant and the informant was threatened also.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the relationship was consensual.
Both the victim and the applicant stayed for a long together.
A child was also born out from their relationship.
It is not a case of rape at all.
5. Learned State counsel would submit that the victim has supported the prosecution case during trial.
6. Having considered the entirety of facts, this Court is of the view that this is a case fit for anticipatory bail.
7 The anticipatory bail application is allowed.

8. In addition to it, the applicant shall also comply with the following conditions:
(i) The applicant shall co-operate with the investigation.
(ii) The applicant shall not approach any witness in any manner, whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) The applicant shall deposit his passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.
(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.
